claim: All 24 isolated prescribed-input pressure comparisons pass three successive GPU steps. No speed claim or complete machine acceptance.

cpuProof.sourceReduction: Only the compact color mapping/entrypoints are appended on opt-in. The original complete WGSL source remains byte-exact when off.
limitations: CPU mocks and source coverage do not prove actual shader compilation, GPU buffer equality, timing, hydraulic delivery or native particle determinism.

limits: Explicit isolated pressure steps with prescribed native-grid inputs are not full-machine elapsed-time or hydraulic acceptance.
Actual air state and native-grid velocities are compared. Native particle gather/collision, native overlap and rendered targets are outside this fixture.
Direct gather construction uses an unused no-op module; actual transport storage is read. MAC mode prescribes records and disables only its fixture scatter/normalize before hook.
A private CPU observer exposes pressure ping-pong and transport references identically in both sources without changing GPU commands. Raw and served source hashes are distinct.

nextGates: Actual native particle scatter, pressure, gather, collision and rendering comparison across all three machines.
Paired GPU timestamps and playback measurements with original scheduler.
Full physical windows and three-seed checks before any behavior acceptance.
notEstablished: General bubble motion, phase accuracy or energy closure

candidateDecision.interpretation: The short cup trial does not demonstrate a performance gain. Further timing and the full cup physical suite are not warranted for this candidate.

limitations: Default browser cadence retains Chrome frame limiting and vsync defaults. Headless RAF callbacks are not measured display FPS. Uncapped cadence is a separate diagnostic.
Every compact off/on row uses identical profile instrumentation and the exact same candidate module. The constructor option is the only intended variant.
Profile appends query resolution/copy commands after original encoder work and asynchronously maps them. Original pass/dispatch/submit order is retained, but timing overhead is real.

GPU group times cover native liquid passes, MAC transfer, combined air topology/pressure, native gather and native liquid rendering. Copies, queue writes, gaps and other devices are excluded from group sums.
Air topology and pressure dispatches share one existing liquid.air.step pass. This harness measures their combined cost without splitting or reordering it.
CPU encoder wall spans include JS work and observer overhead, not GPU execution. Host function profiles overlap and must not be added together.
Whole-submit queue completion includes earlier backlog, submission, observer tail copies and promise delivery. It is not a GPU-only timer.
Timestamp samples are sparse, pool-bounded and may drop when maps lag. Raw coverage/drop counts are retained; missing timestamps do not become zero cost.
Paired natural trajectories can differ as throughput changes. Timing is not state equivalence or original machine physical acceptance.
Optional serialized native bench includes the actual liquid/air chain and waits each frame. It excludes host jello/geometry/render work and is not sustained presentation.

fullChainRecorderFirstAttempt.reason: Observer requires COPY_SRC for the native indirect dispatch buffer, which default allocation lacks. Native update caught the observer error and the recorder reported a generic fallback. A separate observer-only revision is being prepared; no full-chain acceptance follows.
